title: Average Value of Even Numbers That Are Divisible by Three
summary: For an array of positive integers, calculate the average of even numbers that are divisible by three, rounding down to the nearest integer.
statement: For an array of positive integers, calculate the average of even numbers that are divisible by three, rounding down to the nearest integer.
constraints: Select values divisible by both two and three.
Return zero when no value qualifies.
hints: Divisibility by both two and three is equivalent to divisibility by six.
Collect or count values with value%6==0.
Return their sum divided by their count, or zero for an empty selection.
The filter exactly represents both divisibility conditions, so its arithmetic mean is the requested value.
